steps.en: Scaffold a deck workspace and start the dev server
steps.zh: 生成一个 deck 工作区，启动开发服务器

steps.en: Serves a hot-reloading 1920×1080 viewer and drops its agent skills into the workspace
steps.zh: 起热更新的 1920×1080 预览器，把 agent skill 放进工作区

steps.en: Ask your coding agent for a deck in one line
steps.zh: 在编码 agent 里用一句话要一套 deck

steps.en: Its skill has the agent ask four scoping questions, then write the React pages
steps.zh: skill 让 agent 先问四个问题，再写 React 页面

steps.en: Click elements in the browser preview and attach comments
steps.zh: 在浏览器预览里点选元素，写上修改意见

steps.en: Saves each comment into the source as a marker next to the element
steps.zh: 把每条意见作为标记写进源码，贴在对应元素旁

steps.en: Have the agent apply every pending comment
steps.zh: 让 agent 一次处理所有待办意见

value.en: A presentable, exportable deck built by your agent, revised by pointing at slides instead of writing JSX yourself
value.zh: 一套由 agent 写好、可直接演示和导出的 deck；改稿只需在页面上指指点点，不用自己写 JSX

sources: https://github.com/open-slide/open-slide README Get started (npx @open-slide/cli init my-slide; cd my-slide; pnpm dev) and Highlights (Agent-native authoring: /create-slide asks four scoping questions; In-browser inspector: comments persisted as @slide-comment markers, /apply-comments applies them)

apps/web/content/docs/getting-started.mdx (scaffolded tree with slides/, themes/, .agents/skills/; dev server with HMR, inspector and assets panel; /create-slide writes slides/<id>/index.tsx; Iterate visually steps 1-4)
packages/core/skills/create-slide/SKILL.md (Step 2: four style decisions via AskUserQuestion; writes only under slides/<id>/)
